subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: What recovery contract should OpenClaw expose when Telegram or session status detects malformed, empty, unreadable, or oversized persisted session JSON?
rationale: The source evidence shows the defect path, but choosing between diagnostics-only, explicit reset, or automatic quarantine affects user state preservation and channel recovery semantics.

options.title: Diagnostics first
options.body: Report file path, size, parse/schema status, and a clear suggested next step without mutating session state until maintainers approve the repair UX.

options.title: Explicit backup reset
options.body: Add a command such as a Telegram/session reset with backup that moves the bad artifact aside and recreates clean state under user control.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: On load failure, move the bad artifact aside automatically and recreate clean state, accepting possible session continuity loss for faster channel recovery.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Report file path, size, parse/schema status, and a clear suggested next step without mutating session state until maintainers approve the repair UX.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sits across Telegram plugin status, session-store recovery, and repository state-policy boundaries where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
